title: Tuple Swap Trick
prompt: a = 1 and b = 2 are given. Swap them WITHOUT a temp variable — Python's tuple assignment: a, b = b, a. Print a then b.

tests.name: swapped
tests.code:
assert printed == ["2", "1"], f"got {printed}"
assert "a, b = b, a" in code, "use tuple assignment"
tests.hint: a, b = b, a — the Pythonic swap.
